Answer: B
Reason: Pneumonic-type lung adenocarcinoma is distinctively characterized by cystic airspaces or lucencies within areas of consolidation (often due to tumor-induced check-valve obstruction or necrosis), whereas infectious pneumonia typically presents as solid consolidation; the red arrow in Figure 1 points to such a cystic lucency within the right-sided opacity, supporting malignancy over infection. *(guided by t000002)*
